master.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: six-panel visual storyboard for an 18-second personalized brand outreach video, a single contact sheet. This is concept art for review, not finished video.
Input image 1 is the authoritative existing character face, blond cornrow braids, warm medium-brown skin, build, and polished PS2 game rendering. Image 2 is the established penthouse world, dusk violet-orange London skyline, tan leather armchair, glass table, wooden floor. Preserve this exact recognizable character rather than redesigning him.
Make a clean 3 columns by 2 rows board, each image panel in vertical 9:16 composition with slim dark separators. Tiny simple panel numbers 01 to 06 only in gutters. No other text, captions, HUD, watermarks or speech balloons.
All six show the SAME character in a plain washed-blue zip hoodie, light gray pants, white sneakers, same world and lighting. Actual early-2000s PS2 cutscene visuals, compressed textures, mildly angular geometry, game lighting, not modern glossy CGI.
01: medium close frontal greeting from tan chair, alert open eyes, mischievous half-smile, one relaxed right hand lifted beside shoulder in greeting, chest visible.
02: physically distinct low wide three-quarter view from beside coffee table. He has leaned forward with both feet now planted on floor preparing to stand. Chair behind him. Entire outfit visible. This depicts the start pose of a rise.
03: he is now standing beside the same chair facing camera, full body in frame, hands loosely at sides, calm self-important game protagonist expression. His stance and camera are different from frame 02. Show the completion of the rise.
04: clean three-quarter waist-up standing garment reveal, arms comfortably separated from the torso so hoodie construction is readable; no pointing at chest, no hand over logo area.
05: medium standing front-on direct address, small natural open right-palm gesture below chest level, attentive open eyes and shoulders. Same chair visible behind left.
06: tight waist-up direct address with one restrained knowing smile and subtle downward indication using right index finger below waistline, leave lower margin uncluttered for later brief link added outside generation.
Composition: storytelling cutscene frames, varied physical camera positions, coherent single room geography. No extra people, food bags, new props, new logos or furniture. Do not duplicate characters. Character identity, hairline, skin tone, facial proportions, garment, furniture and lighting must remain consistent across all panels.

wardrobes.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: wardrobe concept comparison board for personalized outreach video, four portrait panels arranged 2 columns by 2 rows. Supporting images show the exact original character and established room. Preserve his face, warm brown skin, blond cornrow braids pulled backward, facial proportions, build, calm confidence, and early-2000s PS2 cutscene rendering.
Input image 1 is the master six-frame storyboard. Input image 2 is the original face reference. Make FOUR new panels maintaining the world, subject identity, tan armchair and violet dusk London windows. Tiny unobtrusive labels in thin dark gutters: upper and lower LEFT 'GYMSHARK CONCEPT'; upper and lower RIGHT 'ALO CONCEPT'. No other copy or watermarks. These are clothing directions, not exact product catalog renders.
TOP LEFT: standing full-body pose from frame 03 of the master; black athletic short sleeve training tee, charcoal tapered training trousers, white sneakers. Small understated light-gray Gymshark wordmark at wearer's left chest, no huge typography. Hands relaxed at sides, chest and trousers readable.
TOP RIGHT: exactly the same pose and framing as top left but an off-white relaxed crewneck sweatshirt, light stone-gray relaxed sweatpants, same white sneakers, tiny silver 'alo' mark at wearer's left chest. No hood or zipper. Same character's head and face.
BOTTOM LEFT: medium direct-address frame matching master frame 05 in same black Gymshark tee and charcoal pants; one small open palm gesture below chest, face alert.
BOTTOM RIGHT: same medium pose and framing in Alo off-white crewneck and light stone-gray pants. Same right hand gesture, exact character.
Garment construction must stay consistent within each column. Retain simplified game textures, waxy early-console skin, warm interior lighting, simple game shadows, angular early-console geometry. Not modern AAA, glossy CGI, live action or fashion photography. Torso uncovered by hands, logos legible but restrained, hands anatomically coherent. No props or extra characters. The only changes between left and right columns are shirt and pants.
